name: cast-six-skills
prompt: Create a production-quality hand-painted fantasy tactical RPG VFX concept sprite sheet, EFFECTS ONLY on true transparent RGBA background. No characters, scenery, UI, letters, symbols of text, labels, numbers, borders or checkerboard. EXACT regular grid 3 columns x 6 rows, equal cells, generous transparent gutters, all effects isolated fully inside cell. Read left to right: preparation, signature peak, dissolution. Every cell uses the same centered floor anchor at about 65% cell height, small modest wide low silhouette, airy open center protecting a character standing there. High quality painted tapered luminous strokes with little sharp pearly core, mint colored edges, minimal soft glow and very sparse sparks; rich restrained detail visible when scaled to 60px wide. NOT generic circular rings everywhere, no giant vertical aura, opaque fills, thick beam, medical plus sign, shield polygon, attack slash or white flash. Six distinct authored shape languages. Row 1 HEAL: seafoam mint small cupped leaf petals gathering inward, peak three tender asymmetric open petals cradling a tiny central restorative light, dissolve into 3 tiny upward dew specks. Single recipient, gentle precise shape. Row 2 PRAYER: pale mint and warm ivory paired curved seed-leaves opening symmetrically out to the sides close to ground, peak a shallow open fan of five slender rays like a small benediction with a central gap, dissolve paired tiny flecks. Intended repeated per actually healed ally, no long connecting wave. Row 3 ROUSE GUARD: pale amber and cool jade, preparation two small parallel footprint crescent anchors, peak two sturdy opposing short low brackets standing beside one another, one brighter protector bracket and one quiet companion bracket; unambiguous standing-beside protection, NO healing petals or rising restorative specks; dissolve into short warm dashes. Row 4 REVIVE: soft ivory-gold with mint edges, preparation tiny ember at floor, peak a low split dawn blossom with two upward tapered luminous tongues near its sides and open central area, more momentous than heal yet low and transparent; dissolution three light motes drifting from floor, NOT wings enclosing body or overhead halo. Row 5 BLESS CAST ONLY: pale chartreuse and pearl, preparation one closed seed of light near floor, peak a suspended faceted almond seed between two tiny asymmetric leaves, like a promised blessing planted not immediate healing; dissolve to a quiet single seed with two tiny flecks, NO heal pulse. Row 6 MEND SONG START ONLY: cool mint-teal with lilac accent, preparation two tiny curled string wisps, peak three elegant short separated low musical ribbon curls with no literal music-note icon, quiet rhythmic lengths, dissolve to two fine curled wisps, NO heal burst. Consistent soft painterly premium 2D game asset style across all rows, medium light weight, preserve true transparency including dark areas; no black rectangular background. Output tall sheet, exact 3 by 6 cells.

name: upkeep-two-skills

Very small local ground-level effects with open center, protect character clothing; no big full-body aura. Fine sharp ivory core, mint-green edging, very restrained glow. Each effect centered and anchored at same floor baseline, and fully isolated within cell. Row1 BLESS RENEW ACTUAL HEAL TICK, distinct from cast seed: the seed opens into two little pointed pale chartreuse leaves with two tiny mint droplets inward, peak two asymmetrical tender leaves under a small dew star offset to left, dissolve two tiny dew lights. This is a local actual healing acknowledgment at a recipient, not a cast buff symbol. Row2 MEND ACTUAL ROUND-START HEAL, distinct from song start at bard: a soft low mint and lilac scalloped ripple made of three short separated curled ribbons, peak a tiny pearly restorative drop between the low curls, dissolve two delicate curled strokes. NOT literal music-note icons. Low horizontal forms about 3:1, restrained readable silhouette at 60px width, no shockwave rings, no attack slash. Consistent painterly luminous organic style. Output wide landscape sheet, three equal columns and two equal rows.
